policy.assignment_rule: Allocate a PET number only on creating an individual dossier; recording an album observation alone never allocates a PET number
policy.ordering_rule: PET numbers are stable assignment order, not year, rarity, family, power, official PC ID or SPR number
policy.reuse_rule: NEVER_REUSE_OR_RENUMBER; redirects/tombstones preserve earlier handles and history
policy.name_rule: Names are versioned claims, can change without changing catalog or evidence identifiers
policy.relation_rule: Same image, same name, same numeric graphics, translated name or identical SPR SHA is only a possible cross-version link; do not merge identities without qualified species evidence
policy.source_value_rule: Retain game-original numbers as namespaced source values such as TW10.SPR_GRAPHIC=100250; never infer a real official PET ID
policy.split_merge_rule: Potential same-species variants tracked as tentative relations; confirmed merge uses redirects preserving aliases, and distinct variant records remain edition scoped; do not silently overwrite originals
policy.future_systems: Separate historical evidence from eventual new single-player game design IDs; do not allow design numbers to backfill historical original values
policy.missing_field_rule: Unknown is null and evidence status OPEN_NOT_PROVEN, not 0, false, invented coordinates or community-stat values
